company.name: Adri Ai (yc)
company.shortDescription: Adri AI builds AI agents that automate SAP development, code generation, and ERP migration workflows for enterprises.
company.description: Adri AI builds AI agents that support SAP development and ERP transformations. The platform covers tasks from requirement analysis and research to ABAP code generation, testing, and deployment in ECC, S/4HANA, and BTP systems. Its Research Agent searches millions of SAP objects to decide configuration versus custom code and generate configuration guides. Adri connects to clients’ SAP landscapes, runs technical assessments, modernizes code, and prepares transports. It offers free, starter, professional, and enterprise plans for consultants, system integrators, and in-house SAP teams.
company.headquarters: South San Francisco, Pennsylvania, United States
